mapper.select: SELECT t.* FROM `${ticketTable}` t JOIN `${itemTable}` i ON t.`${itemFk}`=i.id WHERE i.owner_username=#{owner} AND t.status=#{status} ORDER BY t.id DESC
SELECT * FROM `${ticketTable}` WHERE `${itemFk}`=#{itemId} AND status='approved' ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT i.title FROM `${ticketTable}` t JOIN `${itemTable}` i ON t.`${itemFk}`=i.id WHERE t.username=#{username} AND t.`${itemFk}`<>#{itemId} AND t.status IN ('pending','pending_mid','pending_final','approved','overdue') AND i.mutex_code=#{mutexCode} AND i.mutex_code<>''

SELECT i.title AS title, i.start_at AS start_at, i.end_at AS end_at FROM `${ticketTable}` t JOIN `${itemTable}` i ON t.`${itemFk}`=i.id WHERE t.username=#{username} AND t.`${itemFk}`<>#{itemId} AND t.status IN ('pending','pending_mid','pending_final','approved','overdue') AND i.start_at IS NOT NULL AND i.end_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `${ticketTable}` WHERE peer_username=#{username} AND peer_ack=0 AND status IN ('pending','pending_mid')
SELECT * FROM `${ticketTable}` WHERE peer_username=#{username} AND peer_ack=0 AND status IN ('pending','pending_mid') ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id FROM `${ticketTable}` WHERE status='hold_ready' AND hold_expire_at IS NOT NULL AND hold_expire_at < NOW()
SELECT status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM `${ticketTable}` GROUP BY status
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(apply_at,'%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS value FROM `${ticketTable}` WHERE apply_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(apply_at,'%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(contact_channel),''),'未填') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM `${ticketTable}` GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(contact_channel),''),'未填') ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT COALESCE(i.title, CONCAT('编号', t.`${itemFk}`)) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM `${ticketTable}` t LEFT JOIN `${itemTable}` i ON t.`${itemFk}`=i.id WHERE t.status IN ('approved','overdue','returned','lost','compensated') GROUP BY t.`${itemFk}`, i.title ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT * FROM `${progressTable}` WHERE ticket_id=#{ticketId} ORDER BY id
